item.title: Fatal Overnight Shooting In SF's Rincon Hill Area Leaves One Dead
item.description: There was a fatal shooting early Monday on SF's Rincon Hill, near the entrance to the Bay Bridge, that left one person dead.

item.title: Dog Rescued From McCovey Cove After Jumping In After Bird
item.description: A San Francisco Fire Department rescue team succeeded in saving a dog named Kobe who jumped into the Bay Sunday afternoon chasing a bird and then became trapped under a pier with nowhere to get out of the water.

item.title: Accident on Hyde Street Cable Car Injures Two Passengers
item.description: There was a minor cable car accident Monday on the Hyde Street line, the circumstances of which are not entirely clear, and two passengers were reportedly treated for injuries.

item.title: Right-Wingers Have Super Bowl Epiphany That San Francisco Is Actually Quite Lovely After All
item.description: Conservative sports bros rolled into SF for the Super Bowl declaring “We’ve been told this place is a sh*thole.” After seeing the sights and taking in some Square Pie Guys, they were singing the city’s praises.

item.title: Possible Active Shooter Situation In Oakland's Pill Hill Neighborhood
item.description: After apparent shots were fired Monday morning, police responded to a residential street in Oakland's Pill Hill neighborhood, where an armed suspect has reportedly barricaded themselves inside an apartment.

item.title: San Francisco Schools Will Remain Closed Tuesday as Strike Negotiations Continue
item.description: After a rally in Civic Center, and as negotiations continued between reps for the SF Unified School District and the United Educators of San Francisco, the district announced that schools would remain closed a second day on Tuesday.

item.title: Trump Administration Trying to Boot All Undocumented Immigrants Out of SF Public Housing
item.description: The latest ‘Show me your papers’ bully move from the Trump administration seems to want immigrants out of any supportive housing that receives federal funding, and they're demanding citizenship checks of Section 8 residents.

item.title: Seahawks Desecrate 49ers’ Locker Room With Cigar Smoke After Winning Super Bowl
item.description: After knocking the 49ers out of the playoffs, the Seattle Seahawks rubbed it in even harder after winning the Super Bowl Sunday night on the Niners' home field, hotboxing the 49ers locker room with the awful smell of cigars.

item.title: In First Big Governor’s Race Endorsement, Senator Adam Schiff Endorses Eric Swalwell
item.description: A sleepy race to succeed Gavin Newsom as California Governor just got a little bit of a jolt, as Senator Adam Schiff publicly put his chips on East Bay House Representative Eric Swalwell.

item.title: Day Around the Bay: Richard Tillman Pleads Guilty In San Jose Arson Case
item.description: 49ers DL Keion White was shot in the ankle at an SF nightclub early Monday; Richard Tillman, the brother of Pat Tillman, has pleaded guilty to setting fire to a San Jose post office; and Scott Wiener denies snubbing Mayor Lurie.
